tenderSchedule.title: Supply of Manpower of different categories to DSERT, Mass education, DSERT Guest House and SERIC Library
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Manpower of different categories to DSERT, Mass education, DSERT Guest House and SERIC Library

tenderAddress.blockNumber: DSERT, 100 FT Ring road, Hosakerehalli, Bengaluru-85

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and condition as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have a Company Registrated under the provision of the Companies Act or Firm/Organization Registered in Karnataka with the competent Authority
The Company / firm should have been in the business for providing Man power Resource at least for the last 3 years
Company/firm should have a certificate of legal status, Place of Registration and Principal place of business of the Firm. Renewal of registration should be produced

The Company Should have registered their firm as per the private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act-2005 & the Private Security Agencies (Karnataka) Rule-2008 with competent authority and registration shall be valid till the completion of the tender service

Company/Firm/Organization should have a GST Registration and have filed the returns as per prevailing rules. Copy of latest GSTR-3B (Sept-2026) form and annual returns filed for the year 2025 shall be upladed in the portal.

Company/firm/organzation should have a average annual turnover of Rs 1.00cr during the past 3 audited years i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 and turnovers certificate issued by charted accountant should be registered and have UDIN No Mandatory.
Final accounts (profit/loss and balance sheet) duely certified by CA with UDIN No work for past 3 audited years i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
self declaration of firm /organisation relating to block list/debarred

The Bidder quoting the lowest service charge(%) shall be considered as the Lowest bidder(L-1). In the event that more than one bidder quotes the same lowest service charge(L-1), The Director DSERT shall have the discretion to adopt an appropriate method and take a final decision for selection of a single successful bidder.

The Bidder Should submit the minimum 03 Satisfactory certificate Regarding the supply of Manpower to Government Departments and Minimum 03 Satisfactory Certificate regarding the supply of Man power to Non -Government for the Years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

The Company/Firm/Organization should have previous experience, Annual Turnover, GST Registration and Income Tax Returns, EPF and ESI Registration for Last three Financial Years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26
Company/firm should have a Average Annual Turnover of Rs.1.00 crore during the past three audited years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Company/firm should have an acknowledgement of Income Tax returns filed in the last three years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copy of pan card should be provided Company/firm should have EPF Registration and EPF returns filed in the last three financial years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Company/firm should have a ESI Registration and ESI returns filed in the last three financial years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
